actions.factored_source: SYNTHETIC fixture action only: 1.5 times reference for a numerical example. Not an adopted code combination or actual project factored action.
actions.note: Uniform footing weight acts downward and cancels its own uniform upward reaction in NET RC cuts. Service soil checks use gross actions. No automatic load factors.

transfer.sign_convention: r = old reference - new reference; M_new = M_old + r × F. Right-handed East/North/Up. Source analytical moment about -North maps to ENU My=-M_source.

inputs.source: Synthetic homogeneous surface phi-zero undrained idealization; no groundwater. Explicit stiffness and strength are independent inputs; no site investigation.
inputs.applicability: Synthetic homogeneous rigid footing, uniform Winkler stiffness, concentric service gross actions only.

contact.sign_convention: East x; applied My positive; soil upward reaction has My=-integral(x*p*dA). w downward=delta+theta*x; theta about positive North.
limitations: Uniform independent linear springs and rigid footing; no continuum soil interaction
Synthetic stiffness is not a measured soil modulus or allowable settlement
No shear, torsion, biaxial contact, capacity, concrete/reinforcement, groundwater, IS/US checks or physical transfer approval
contact.formulas: Full: delta=N/(kBL), theta=M/(k LB^3/12). Partial: a=3(B/2-|M/N|), pmax=2N/(La), theta=sign(M)*pmax/(ka), delta=pmax/(ka)*(a-B/2).

bearing.formula: Nc=pi+2; sc=1+B/(5L); q_ult=su*Nc*sc; A=B*L; Q_ult=q_ult*A; q_reference=q_ult/FS; q_applied=N_total/A. Df=0, phi=0: surcharge and unit-weight terms zero.
bearing.reference_note: FHWA GEC 6 (2002), printed pp.51-56; Eq.5-2, Table5-1 and Table5-2 phi=0 row; sc=1+B/(5L), sq=sgamma=1. This is an implemented reference formulation, not AASHTO/IS/US code compliance.
bearing.units: B,L,elevations m; su and pressures kPa=kN/m2; total loads and resistance kN; moments kN*m; gamma kN/m3.

Footing/anchor/concrete capacity, IS/US compliance, soil suitability and engineering approval disabled

methods.units: B,c,h,d,bo,cover,spacing in mm; As mm2; strengths MPa=N/mm2; pressure kPa; actions kN/kN m
methods.depth: EW d=h-cover-diaEW/2; NS d=h-cover-diaEW-diaNS/2. Orthogonal touching bottom layers, EW lower.
methods.demands: a=(B-c)/2; Vu_oneway=q_u*(B/1000)*max(a-d,0)/1000; bo=4*(c+min(dEW,dNS)); Vu_punch=q_u*(B^2-(c+d)^2)/1e6. No unbalanced moment.
methods.ACI_shear: Original IN-LB coefficients: Vc_1=2*sqrt(fc_psi)*b_in*d_in lbf; vc_p=min(4,2+4/beta,40*d/bo+2)*sqrt(fc_psi) psi; beta=1, lambda=1, phi_v=.75. Convert using 25.4mm/in and 4.4482216152605N/lbf.
methods.ACI_flexure: Existing nominal section service, alpha=beta1=.85, epsilon_cu=.003, fc cylinder20..28MPa. phi=.9 only if epsilon_t>=.005. Existing nominal solver strain-domain ceiling .05 retained.
methods.IS_flexure: T=.87fy*As; xu=T/(.36fck*b); Mdesign=T*(d-.42xu); xu/d <=.48 Fe415 or .46 Fe500. Cube fck is independently declared; no nominal/design conversion.
methods.IS_punching: ks=min(.5+shortColumn/longColumn,1)=1; tau_design=.25*sqrt(fck); Vdesign=tau_design*bo*d/1000. Smaller orthogonal d used conservatively.
methods.IS_development: Ld=dia*(.87fy)/(4*tau_bd); deformed tension tau_bd=1.6*[1.2,1.4,1.5,1.7,1.9] for M20/25/30/35/40. Straight available length from column face to end =a-cover; no hooks/curtailment/dowels.
